name: Hiking
subtitle: Day hikes and highland walks arranged from Afghanistan’s travel hubs.
card_description: Guided hiking arranged from operational hubs — valleys, viewpoints, and highland paths scoped around current access. Not a fixed trail catalog.
best_season: Varies by hub and route (subject to conditions)
duration: Varies — half day to full day; discuss during planning

name: Fishing
subtitle: Fishing in Afghanistan can be as relaxed or as dedicated as you want it to be.
card_description: Add a few hours of fishing to a wider itinerary, or plan a private Custom Journey around it.
duration: A few hours within a tour, up to a dedicated fishing journey

name: Trekking
subtitle: Faizabad-planned highland trekking scoped by time, difficulty, season, route, and access.
card_description: Trekking arranged from Faizabad — paced by your brief and current conditions, not one packaged multi-day expedition.
best_season: Varies by season and access (subject to conditions)
duration: Varies by time, difficulty, route, and access — discuss during planning

name: Skiing
subtitle: Bamyan is our established ski destination, but skiing in Afghanistan is not limited to the Bamyan Ski Tour.
card_description: Join the Bamyan Ski Tour, add time on the snow to another itinerary, or plan a private ski-focused Custom Journey.
best_season: Winter–early spring, depending on snow and access
duration: Time within a tour, a dedicated extension, or a private ski journey

name: Shopping
subtitle: Bazaars, craft streets, and market browsing from every active hub.
card_description: Guided bazaar and craft shopping planned from each operational hub — carpets, copper, dried fruit, and local specialties.
duration: Varies — typically 1–3 hours; discuss during planning

name: Sightseeing
subtitle: City and field sightseeing routed from every active hub.
card_description: Hub-based sightseeing across historic, religious, scenic, and market contexts — the backbone of most Afghan journeys.
duration: Varies — half day to full day; discuss during planning

name: Horse Riding
subtitle: Equestrian outings linked to Kabul and Mazar corridors.
card_description: Horse-riding experiences planned from Kabul and Mazar-e-Sharif when local horses, handlers, and routes are available.
best_season: Varies (subject to horses, handlers, and routes)
duration: Varies — typically 1–3 hours; discuss during planning

name: Cycling
subtitle: Urban and near-hub cycling around Kabul when conditions allow.
card_description: Cycling as a soft-adventure option arranged from the Kabul hub — route and timing confirmed case by case.
duration: Varies — typically 1–3 hours; discuss during planning

name: Birding
subtitle: Birding can be incorporated naturally into many AfghanTours itineraries.
card_description: Add time for birdlife observation to most tours, or plan a private itinerary around particular habitats and target species.
best_season: Varies by region, habitat and season
duration: Extra observation time within a tour, up to a private birding itinerary
